blockers.condition: overrides is a map with flags:null and/or payloads:null
blockers.blocks: Assertions about the effect of those individual null submaps; the input remains representable.
blockers.does_not_block: Top-level overrides:null clears all; omitted submaps stay unchanged; false flag values remain values.
blockers.decision_needed: Define the effect of each individually null submap.

blockers.condition: Unsent records have moved from the public queue into a worker-held batch
blockers.blocks: Assertions whose expected count depends on inclusion of those records.
blockers.does_not_block: Unambiguous public queue observations and unrelated capture/flush behavior.
blockers.decision_needed: Define whether the public pending count includes worker-held unsent records.

blockers.condition: A returned native value cannot be represented losslessly by the operation's JSON/typed reference result or void/undefined outcome
blockers.blocks: Only the affected result assertion/profile; report blocked_contract with the concrete call ID and native type evidence.
blockers.does_not_block: Native Unit/void, actual undefined, JSON values, declared retained references, or actual thrown exceptions.
blockers.decision_needed: Select lossless observation for the encountered native result alternative. A returned error is not a thrown error.
